newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa JSE suspends Mashold, Mascon.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa JSE suspends Mashold, Mascon.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) said it had suspended the listings of Mas Holdings Ltd (Mashold) and holding firm Mashold Consolidated Investment Holdings Ltd from the start of business on Wednesday, pending clarification on the future of the firm.
It said this was expected to be given by the mail order company on August 4.
The JSE said that the securities would remain in the JSE Actuaries all share, financial and industrial, industrial, small capitalisation and store indices for five days.
If after this time the suspension had not been lifted the securities would be removed from the indices.

In the year to December 31, 1996 Mashold reported a headline earnings loss of 98.0 cents compared with a profit of 53.3 cents before. The directors said at the time that the firm was expected to return to profit in 1997.
